entities.summary: Yerköy is a town in Yozgat Province in the Central Anatolia region of Turkey. It is the seat of Yerköy District. Its population is 27,084 (2022). Its elevation is 771 m (2,530 ft). The mayor is Fatih Arslan, Justice and Development Party.
